SOURCE-ASSISTED SELECTED READING OF FOL. F (batch of 12 October 2026)

Base: batch-2026-10-12-image-only, which was made from the record's first two canvases (the stub before fol. D and the neighbouring leaves) and does not include fol. F. There is therefore no independent first reading of the text below; the base is cited only because the record format requires one. The lines were read by a research reader from the canvas "fol. F recto" with the OCR text of Giles's edition of Bede, De temporum ratione, chapter 43, to hand; the coordinator checked lines 10-19 on the image. Square brackets mark text lost at the left edge (gutter and worm damage) or not read; parentheses expand abbreviations; a question mark follows an uncertain reading.
